title: NoCapsInChat
description: This is a client side mod to prevent caps-lock from activating in chat. Useful for those who want to use it as a keybind.
body:
# Caps-Lock Disabler

A minimal client-side Fabric mod that disables the Caps-Lock key when typing in chat. That's it.

## Features

- **Caps-Lock Blocked**: The Caps-Lock key simply won't work while you have the chat window open
- **Nothing Else**: Simple
- **Seamless**: Works silently in the background

## Compatibility

- Absolutely minimal
